overview:
**Fire danger is Moderate today, driven by mid-50s ERC/BI readings and low humidity, with no watchout thresholds triggered.**
- Danger dips to Low on Tuesday (Sept 29) as a wetter, cooler pattern moves in, then returns to Moderate by Oct 2 as fuels dry out again.
- NWS calls for sun today with a high near 71, then a slight chance of Sunday afternoon showers/storms as southeast winds pick up slightly.
- No Red Flag Warning is posted; only an NWS Hydrologic Outlook is active, and 0 of 7 local watchout indicators are met.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions remain in effect for BLM lands across Montrose, San Miguel, Ouray, Delta, and part of Gunnison counties; check local county orders for town-limit rules.
- The Gold Mountain Fire near Ouray sits at 39,744 acres and 92% containment, with its final incident update issued in late August, while the Elk Fire in Hinsdale County stands at 7,257 acres and 73% containment; today's national sit report lists no new large fires in this area.
